name: Momo-kan
source:
I met Momoka, one of my childhood friends, at the town I visited again after an interval of 7 years. We happened to start living together in the town.....

时隔七年再次造访的小镇，我遇见了儿时好友桃花。我们碰巧开始在城里一起生活……
